summary: 16 features and 1 fix across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • frontendconfig: default notification sounds to local dev mixkit selection (7d62a3a)
  • voice-reminders: add Mixkit sound pack bundle (9bb0ef6)
  • sessionactivity: add aggregate grain and live session activity summary (9274bec)
  • frontendconfig: add workspace-wide global notification rules (438278e)
  • promote: wire promote relay into DI and HTTP API (c5cbd63)
  • promote: add promote relay service with locale and image caching (2cf52c9)
  • frontendconfig: default theme to spring-light (9f5c09a)
  • orleans: hash full grain id across shards and lock shard count (9aee45c)

HagiCode-org/web

  • notifications: add localized sound catalog and sound picker (204162f)
  • voice-reminder: add Mixkit bundled sound pack catalog (1859a93)
  • git: highlight the primary AI commit action in the git pane (3c0b62c)
  • notifications: add global workspace activity notification rules (6bac997)
  • statusbar: add HagiCode promotion rotation in the status bar (561379d)
  • i18n: add localized strings across UI components (92b1940)
  • i18n: add date-fns locale resolver (7b36f1d)
  • i18n: add localized strings across UI components (6fc6774)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • session: exclude archived chats from select-visible (6a84412)
